Refining her soles, where her threads end, sends a cold jolt up through her loops into her well.

event: Water spills from her grip and her well drops near dry; she finishes the leg and waits an hour.

changes.note: The sole's jolt, met unready, spills her well near dry

memory.fact: Met unready, the sole's jolt shakes Nala's grip and spills her well near dry; ridden, it does not.
Met unready, the sole's jolt shakes Nala's grip and spills her well near dry; ridden, it does not.

event: The Sea fills her well back to the brim, slow and steady, while she sits in the dark.

changes.note: The Sea refills her well within the hour

event: Ready for the sole's jolt this time, she rides it like a wave; the right leg refines smooth, swift.

changes.note: Refining her right leg's skin with Undertow: a hard working

memory.fact: Nala's arms and legs are all refined whole by the night of day three.
Nala's arms and legs are all refined whole by the night of day three.

event: Both legs shine faintly pearly; only her trunk, neck and head are left, thin and raw. She sleeps.

memory.fact: With arms and legs refined, only the skin of Nala's trunk, neck and head is left, the hardest part.
With arms and legs refined, only the skin of Nala's trunk, neck and head is left, the hardest part.
A limb refined whole shows a faint pearly sheen for an hour, then looks like her own skin again.
A limb refined whole shows a faint pearly sheen for an hour, then looks like her own skin again.

event: Day four's dawn: stalls go up on the green for market, and a carrier's cart stands by the Lantern.

memory.fact: Day four is market day: stalls go up on the green at dawn, and the carrier's cart is by the Lantern.
Day four is market day: stalls go up on the green at dawn, and the carrier's cart is by the Lantern.

event: At the Lantern, two coppers buy bread, cheese and cold mutton wrapped for the road.

changes.note: Road food from the Drowned Lantern

memory.fact: From dawn Maddy Fenn sells a day's bread, cheese and cold mutton wrapped for the road, two coppers.
From dawn Maddy Fenn sells a day's bread, cheese and cold mutton wrapped for the road, two coppers.

event: At the tinker's stall, a leather waterskin for three more; she fills it at the well and drinks deep.

changes.note: A leather waterskin from the market tinker

make.title: Leather Waterskin
make.description: A stitched leather waterskin with a wooden stopper and a carrying cord.

changes.note: She buys a waterskin at the market

memory.fact: The market tinker sells a leather waterskin for three coppers and a wool blanket for a silver.
The market tinker sells a leather waterskin for three coppers and a wool blanket for a silver.

event: Day four is grey and still, low cloud just above the snow line; she passes Callow Beck by.

memory.fact: Day four is grey and still, low cloud hanging just above the Whitecombs' snow line.
Day four is grey and still, low cloud hanging just above the Whitecombs' snow line.

event: In the high cwm the black pool lies quiet; she eats bread and mutton on a rock, and climbs on.
Above the cwm the tracks are buried in old snow; she picks her own way up the scree.
Ice-glazed scree shifts, and she slides thirty feet, stones raking her side and hip.

changes.note: A thirty-foot slide on icy scree scrapes and bruises her ribs

memory.fact: On day four a fall on icy scree scraped the unrefined skin over Nala's ribs raw and bruised it deep.
On day four a fall on icy scree scraped the unrefined skin over Nala's ribs raw and bruised it deep.

event: Her refined arms and legs come out unmarked; the skin over her ribs is scraped raw and bruised deep.

memory.fact: Nala's refined arms and legs came through a thirty-foot slide on the scree unmarked.
Nala's refined arms and legs came through a thirty-foot slide on the scree unmarked.

event: The best part of an hour to climb back by a longer, safer way.
Big webbed prints frozen into old ice on the scree, long-strided, all running downhill.

memory.fact: The greymaws' flight from the crag shows as big webbed prints frozen into old ice on the scree.
The greymaws' flight from the crag shows as big webbed prints frozen into old ice on the scree.

event: By half past one she stands under the crag: a grey buttress split top to bottom.

memory.fact: The crag is a grey buttress split top to bottom; fallen blocks bury the den mouth at its foot.
The crag is a grey buttress split top to bottom; fallen blocks bury the den mouth at its foot.

event: Cart-sized blocks bury an old den at its foot, reeking faintly of rotten salt.

memory.fact: The buried den reeks faintly of rotten salt; old greymaw prints lead from it downhill at a run.
The buried den reeks faintly of rotten salt; old greymaw prints lead from it downhill at a run.

event: Cold air breathes out of the split, smelling of the sea.

memory.fact: The split in the crag breathes cold air that smells of the sea.
The split in the crag breathes cold air that smells of the sea.

event: Her well feels something new: a slow, vast pull from far below, a tide under the mountain.

memory.fact: At the split crag Nala's well feels a slow, vast pull from far below, a tide under the mountain.
At the split crag Nala's well feels a slow, vast pull from far below, a tide under the mountain.

event: The rock shivers once; a midwinter quake split this crag, buried the den and drove the pack down.

memory.fact: The split cliff and fled den are sure word: the midwinter quakes shook the greymaws out.
The split cliff and fled den are sure word: the midwinter quakes shook the greymaws out.

event: Five hours back to the Ford, the day half gone; she turns her back on the breathing split.

memory.fact: From the Ford to the split crag is six hours on foot; the way down takes five.
From the Ford to the split crag is six hours on foot; the way down takes five.

event: With every step down the pull fades, until her well lies quiet again.

memory.fact: Walking down from the split crag, the pull on Nala's well fades, and her well lies quiet again.
Walking down from the split crag, the pull on Nala's well fades, and her well lies quiet again.

event: She keeps her feet the safer way, passes the pool and Callow Beck, eating Ebba's cheese.
Dark by the time she crosses the empty green; Tam lets her in, and Dray looks up from the fire.
She tells him of the frozen prints running downhill, the split crag, the buried den.
"A quake. That's what the thunder was, all winter. Sure word." He pays the other half bar.

changes.note: Dray pays the rest of the bar for the split crag

memory.fact: Dray takes the split crag and the fleeing prints as sure word, and pays the rest of the bar.
Dray takes the split crag and the fleeing prints as sure word, and pays the rest of the bar.
This winter thunder rolled over the Whitecombs night after night with no lightning.

event: Then the rest: the sea-cold air from the split, and the vast pull from under the mountain.
"Under the mountain. And the tarn, and the pool, all leaning the same way."

memory.fact: Dray reads the winter's thunder as quakes, and the tarn, pool and mountain as leaning one way.
Dray reads the winter's thunder as quakes, and the tarn, pool and mountain as leaning one way.

event: He'll write Lady Varrow and the Carrowmouth garrison tonight; Wat Brisk takes them at first light.

memory.fact: Told of the pull under the mountain, Dray will write Lady Varrow and the Carrowmouth garrison.
Told of the pull under the mountain, Dray will write Lady Varrow and the Carrowmouth garrison.
The carrier is Wat Brisk, who drives a covered cart to Carrowmouth and back each week.
The carrier is Wat Brisk, who drives a covered cart to Carrowmouth and back each week.
Wat Brisk sleeps at the Lantern on market night and leaves for Carrowmouth at first light.
Wat Brisk sleeps at the Lantern on market night and leaves for Carrowmouth at first light.

event: He asks her to keep the pull under the mountain to herself till he has word back.

memory.fact: Dray asks Nala to keep the pull under the mountain from the village until he has word back.
Dray asks Nala to keep the pull under the mountain from the village until he has word back.

event: And Crake: his men robbed a drover on the Carrowmouth road ten days ago, a day's walk below.

memory.fact: Crake's men robbed a drover on the Carrowmouth road ten days ago, a day's walk below the Ford.
Crake's men robbed a drover on the Carrowmouth road ten days ago, a day's walk below the Ford.
